title: HR coordinator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Overview:
Weare seeking an experienced and customer-focused HR Coordinator to providehigh-quality administrative and operational HR support across the employeelifecycle. As a key member of the HR team, you will be the first point ofcontact employees and managers, ensuring efficient HR service deliverywhile maintaining accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality.

Location:Basingstoke, UK (On-site)
Contract:12-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Hours:Full-Time, 37 hours per week
Start Date: September/October
Salary: A per hour rate, in-scope IR35 of £15 -£17 per hour

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for HR-related queries from employees and managers.
- Provide guidance on HR policies, procedures, and employee life cycle processes.
- Support employees throughout their employment journey and ensure a positive experience.
- Escalate complex employee relations and compliance matters when required.
- Manage HR administration across the employee life cycle, including:
- New hire administration and onboarding
- Employee transfers, promotions, and organisational changes
- Leave and absence of administration
- Offboarding and termination processes
- Prepare and maintain HR documentation, correspondence, and employee records.
- Coordinate onboarding activities to ensure a seamless employee experience.
- Partner with Payroll to ensure employee changes are processed accurately and on time.
- Assist with benefits administration and employee queries.
- Support annual compensation and benefits review processes.
- Participate in HR projects and organisational initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
- 3-5 years of experience in HR Administration, HR Operations, Shared Services, or a similar HR support role.
- Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent organizational and prioritisation abilities.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
- Experience handling confidential employee data.
- Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred
- Fluency in a second European language (German, French, Spanish, Italian, or Dutch).
- Experience supporting employees across multiple countries.
- Experience with HRIS platforms such as Darwin box, Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar.
- Knowledge of end-to-end employee life cycle processes.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or equivalent HR administration experience.

Ifyou are interested or anyone who you may know, please send across a copy ofyour/their most recent CV and availability for a chat by tomorrow.

Hays Talent Solutions is a trading division of Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited and acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. title: HR Coordinator
description:
Role: HR Coordinator

Location: Basingstoke

Contract Length: 12 Months

Salary: £28,860 to £32,708

Randstad has partnered with an independent Microbiology business.

The role

In this role, you'll be at the heart of the HR function, acting as its operational backbone. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality administrative and operational HR support across the employee lifecycle. Serving as the first point of contact for employees and managers, you will provide timely guidance, process HR transactions, and maintain accurate employee records. Furthermore, you will help establish efficient and scalable HR processes, ensuring a positive employee experience while maintaining compliance, accuracy, and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities
- Serve as a point of contact for day-to-day HR queries from employees and managers, providing guidance on HR policies and procedures.
- Manage HR administration activities including new hire administration and onboarding, organisational changes, leave administration, and offboarding.
- Maintain accurate employee records within HR systems and databases, ensuring all data is updated in a timely manner.
- Partner with Payroll to ensure employee changes are processed accurately and on time, and support benefits administration.
- Ensure HR processes comply with company policies and applicable employment legislation, maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive information with discretion.

What you'll bring
- Experience working in an HR Administration, HR Operations, Shared Services, or similar administrative role.
- A strong customer service mindset with excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, alongside strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
- Fluency in English.
- A CIPD Level 3 qualification or equivalent HR administration experience is desirable, as is fluency in a second European language.

Randstad Business Support is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: Job title: Receptionist/Administrator Location: CGH Partnership, Basingstoke Salary: £25,838.00 Hours: 37.5 per week Help us to deliver great primary care by improving access, outcomes and patient experience. At Operose Health, we delivery local primary care, at scale. It is our purpose to improve access, outcomes and patient experience. Our colleagues live our values and our empowered to be the best they can be for our patients, and each other because we CARE. Caring We listen and through compassion, understanding and a willingness to keep an open mind, we support and empower people to have a healthier future. Ambitious Through determination and our passion for transforming the patient experience, we continue to redefine and revolutionise the future of primary care. Resourceful Creative, agile, with a devotion for lifelong learning, we go above and beyond to improve the quality of our services. As a valued member of the Operose Health team, your key duties will include responding to patient queries, liaising with the wider primary care team, managing appointment requests, and signposting patients to our range of services while maintaining patient records and confidentiality. You will also be responsible for emailing, scanning, and coding clinical correspondence, as well as processing prescription requests. Utilising other information systems to support efficient workflow processes is also a critical duty of this role. The ideal candidate will have reception or customer care experience, excellent communication skills both spoken and written, basic PC skills such as Word, Excel, and email, and the ability to work within processes, procedures, and maintain confidentiality and data security. Previous experience of working in the NHS is welcome but not essential.
